subject: Billing contact switchover & invoice delivery terms (portal vs email)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Billing contact switchover & invoice delivery terms (portal vs email)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick summary + ask so we can finalize the billing handoff for Greenlane (deal GF-77823):

- Proposed approach: Redwood sends machine-readable invoices via our portal API (preferred) with a parallel PDF email copy for the first two billing cycles as a fallback. After two cycles we switch to portal-only delivery unless AP asks otherwise.
- Why: portal + API reduces manual reconciliation and supports automated remittance; email copies give your team a safety window.
- Immediate asks for your AP team: please confirm the billing contact and preferred remit email; we also need your VAT/Tax ID to place on invoices for EU/UK accounting (if applicable).

I've attached a sample invoice and a short onboarding checklist so you can see the fields the portal emits. If Greenlane requires signed contractual language about delivery method, we can append an invoice-delivery amendment to the SOW.

Attachments: redwood_sample_invoice_202705.pdf, billing_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Confirm billing contact and remit email by EOD Friday 5/21
2) If you prefer email-only instead of portal, tell us now and we'll set the fallback policy in the contract
3) Connor will follow up on the webhook and API keys once contact is confirmed

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0132

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenlane.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenlane AP <ap@greenlane.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing contact switchover & invoice delivery terms (portal vs email)

Marissa —

Appreciate the summary. A few notes from AP:

- Greenlane prefers receiving PDFs by email to our accounting inbox (ap@greenlane.com) for now due to internal tooling constraints. We are open to transitioning to portal/API but will need a 60-day testing window rather than 2 cycles.
- Our billing contact will be me (Liam O'Connor) for orchestration and Jessica Mills (jessica.mills@greenlane.com) is the AP owner for invoice processing. Please include both on invoice copies.
- VAT/Tax ID: GB999888777 (attach to invoice).
- I've attached our PO for the initial commit (PO-77823.pdf).

If Redwood can guarantee a 60-day parallel email fallback and an audit log export for the portal during the pilot, we can start the API onboarding immediately after contract amendment.

Thanks — I'll wait for your confirmation and the proposed amendment language.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations
Greenlane Labs
liam.oconnor@greenlane.com

Attachment: PO-77823.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing contact switchover & invoice delivery terms (portal vs email)

Liam —

Thanks, that's clear and very helpful. Agreed: we'll extend the parallel email fallback to 60 days for Greenlane and provide an audit-log export for the portal during the pilot. Action items on our side:

- Kimberly, can you and Legal prepare a brief amendment to the SOW stating: portal delivery with 60-day email fallback, audit-log export on request, and VAT ID insertion? Mark it as "Invoice Delivery Addendum (GF-77823)."
- Connor, please scope the onboarding steps: API keys, example webhook payload, and a sample audit-log export. We'll run a 2-week technical pilot once keys are issued.
- Marissa (me): I'll send the amendment draft and the DocuSign link for signing; once signed, we schedule the technical pilot.

I'll include the PO in our handoff packet.

—Marissa

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing contact switchover & invoice delivery terms (portal vs email)

Hi Liam —

Legal has drafted the short "Invoice Delivery Addendum (GF-77823)" that captures the 60-day parallel email fallback, confirmation that VAT ID GB999888777 will be printed on invoices, and Redwood's commitment to provide a portal audit-log CSV on request. Key points:

- Effective date: invoice cycle following DocuSign completion
- Fallback duration: 60 days from first invoice emission
- Technical pilot: Redwood to provide API keys and webhook spec within 3 business days of execution
- PO acceptance: we have PO-77823 on file; this covers the first month of reserved capacity as discussed

DocuSign link: https://redwood.app/docusign/GF-77823/invoice-delivery-amendment

Connor will reach out to set the technical kickoff once you sign. If you want the addendum to state the audit-log frequency (weekly vs monthly), tell us and we will amend.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Contracts & Pricing
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
